title: S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional video diffusion models denoise entire videos in parallel, yet when trained on effectively unlimited in-distribution data from procedural generators, continue to violate physical laws and simple symbolic rules. We introduce Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD), which performs autoregressive diffusion at high noise before switching to parallel diffusion at low noise. The autoregressive phase provides the serial computation needed to coordinate interdependent events and produce valid state transitions while the parallel phase jointly refines the entire video and reduces sampling time relative to fully serial generation. We implement S2PD with two architectures: a pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch and a pretrained video model adapted through LoRA fine-tuning with causal attention. Across games, physical simulations, and real video, S2PD follows rules more reliably than matched bidirectional baselines and generates videos with greater temporal stability and sampling efficiency than other serial methods.
paragraphs.zh: 双向视频扩散模型能够并行地去除整个视频的噪声，但当使用来自程序生成器的、实际上无限量的分布内数据进行训练时，它们仍然会违反物理定律和简单的符号规则。 我们提出了串行到并行扩散（Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion, S2PD）方法，该方法在高噪声阶段执行自回归扩散，然后在低噪声阶段切换到并行扩散。 自回归阶段提供了协调相互依赖事件和生成有效状态转换所需的串行计算，而并行阶段则联合优化整个视频，并相对于完全串行的生成方法缩短了采样时间。 我们通过两种架构实现了 S2PD：一种是从零开始训练的像素空间扩散变换器，另一种是通过因果注意力机制结合 LoRA 微调对预训练视频模型进行适配。 在游戏、物理模拟和真实视频中，S2PD 比匹配的基线双向模型更可靠地遵循规则，并且生成的视频在时间稳定性方面优于其他串行方法，同时采样效率也更高。

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional diffusion transformers such as Wan ( Wan Team, 2025 ) are widely used for large-scale video generation. These models denoise all video tokens in parallel. Although these models achieve high visual fidelity as measured by FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) and VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , multiple studies document morphing artifacts and violations of physical laws in their samples ( Bansal et al., 2026 ; Motamed et al., 2026 ) . We discover a more puzzling result: bidirectional video diffusion transformers continue to exhibit these failures even when trained on effectively unlimited procedurally generated data from relatively simple simulations. Physical accuracy therefore does not emerge from data scaling alone.
paragraphs.zh: 双向扩散变换器（如 Wan (Wan Team, 2025)）被广泛用于大规模视频生成。 这些模型会并行消除所有视频标记的噪声。 尽管这些模型在 FVD (Unterthiner et al., 2018) 和 VBench (Huang et al., 2024) 的衡量下实现了高视觉保真度，但多项研究指出其样本中存在形态扭曲伪影和对物理定律的违背 (Bansal et al., 2026; Motamed et al., 2026)。 我们发现了一个更令人费解的结果：即使使用来自相对简单模拟的有效无限过程生成数据训练，双向视频扩散变换器仍然会出现这类失败。 因此，物理准确性并非仅通过数据扩展就能实现。

paragraphs.en: The Serial Scaling Hypothesis ( Liu et al., 2026 ) offers a theoretical explanation. Liu et al. prove that diffusion models remain in TC 0 \mathrm{TC}^{0} , a class of computations with bounded sequential depth, even with arbitrarily many denoising steps. For standard diffusion models, increasing model depth is the only way to supply the serial computation some problems require. Videos can contain long chains of causally dependent events. We hypothesize that bidirectional diffusion models, early in denoising when the video’s overall structure is ambiguous, assign locally plausible but mutually incompatible events to different space–time regions. Subsequent denoising sharpens these commitments without reconciling them, leading to abrupt changes or invalid transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 串行扩展假说（Liu 等人，2026）提供了一个理论解释。 Liu 等人证明，即使经过任意多的去噪步骤，扩散模型仍属于 TC⁰ 类——一类具有有限序列深度的计算。 对于标准扩散模型而言，增加模型深度是为某些问题提供所需串行计算的唯一方法。 视频可能包含由因果依赖事件构成的长链。 我们假设，在去噪初期，当视频的整体结构尚不明确时，双向扩散模型会将局部看似合理但彼此不兼容的事件分配给不同的时空区域。 后续的去噪过程会强化这些决定，却无法协调它们之间的矛盾，从而导致突变或无效转换。

paragraphs.en: Our solution is to let the model commit to structure serially by generating blocks of video tokens autoregressively. Concurrent work on the Seriality Gap ( Díaz Chao et al., 2026 ) shows that autoregressive generation with increasingly small block sizes reduces errors on colliding ball simulations. We implement two autoregressive diffusion methods and demonstrate a similar pattern across a broad range of games and simulations. We further adapt a large pretrained bidirectional video model for autoregressive generation through LoRA fine-tuning ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on more complex simulations and real video. On real video of a Rubik’s Cube, our models generate realistic hand–cube interactions while maintaining a plausible cube state over time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的解决方案是让模型通过自回归地生成视频分块，以序列化的方式逐步确定结构。 关于“序列性差距”（Seriality Gap）的同步研究（Díaz Chao 等人，2026）表明，采用越来越小的分块尺寸进行自回归生成，能够减少碰撞球体模拟中的错误。 我们实现了两种自回归扩散方法，并在多种游戏和模拟中观察到了相似的模式。 我们还通过 LoRA 微调（Hu 等人，2022），将一个大规模预训练的双向视频模型适配用于更复杂的模拟和真实视频的自回归生成。 在真实拍摄的魔方视频中，我们的模型能够生成逼真的手与魔方之间的互动，同时保持魔方状态在时间上的合理性。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we introduce Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD). Although autoregressive diffusion models follow rules much better than bidirectional diffusion models, they are slow to sample and susceptible to temporal instability and autoregressive drift ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Autoregressive drift occurs when generated content is used as context for generating more content later. Small prediction errors accumulate, causing sampling and training distributions to diverge. Re-noising previously generated blocks can mitigate this drift but it also corrupts the information available to subsequent blocks, causing flicker. S2PD divides sampling into two phases, confining the autoregressive diffusion essential for logical consistency to the high-noise regime, before refining the full sequence in parallel at low noise.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们介绍串行到并行扩散（Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion，S2PD）方法。 尽管自回归扩散模型比双向扩散模型能更好地遵循规则，但它们的采样速度较慢，且容易受到时间不稳定性和自回归漂移的影响（Huang 等，2025）。 当生成的内容被用作后续生成更多内容的上下文时，就会出现自回归漂移。 微小的预测误差会不断累积，导致采样分布和训练分布逐渐发散。 对先前生成的区块进行重新加噪可以缓解这种漂移，但也会破坏后续区块可用的信息，从而产生闪烁现象。 S2PD 将采样分为两个阶段：首先将确保逻辑一致性所必需的自回归扩散限制在高噪声阶段，随后在低噪声阶段以并行方式对完整序列进行优化。

paragraphs.en: We introduce S2PD, which preserves the physical plausibility and logical consistency of serial generation while improving sampling efficiency and temporal stability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 S2PD，它在提升采样效率和时序稳定性的同时，保留了序列生成过程的物理合理性和逻辑一致性。

paragraphs.en: We show that bidirectional diffusion violates physical and symbolic rules despite effectively unlimited procedurally generated in-distribution data, whereas autoregressive diffusion methods substantially reduce these errors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，尽管双向扩散模型能够生成有效且近乎无限的程序化分布内数据，但它仍然违反了物理和符号规则；而自回归扩散方法则能显著减少此类错误。

paragraphs.en: Video Diffusion Models ( Ho et al., 2022 ) extends image diffusion ( Ho et al., 2020 ) to jointly denoise all video tokens in parallel. In contrast, autoregressive video models generate tokens sequentially, using classification for discrete tokens ( Yan et al., 2021 ) or diffusion for continuous tokens. Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) achieves autoregressive video diffusion by training a model to denoise independently noised frames. Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) points out that repeated autoregressive denoising leads to a training–inference distribution mismatch and addresses this by also training on generated video. Block Diffusion ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) introduces a method for generating chunks of text simultaneously to accelerate language modeling. We find block-causal diffusion particularly well suited to video modeling since it can generate whole frames at once. Flex-Forcing ( Ma et al., 2026 ) uses block-causal diffusion with variable block sizes, but they only explore block sizes larger than one frame and use it as an acceleration technique with efficiency–quality trade-offs. We explore block sizes smaller than one frame and study how spatio-temporal autoregression affects logical consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型（Ho et al., 2022）将图像扩散模型（Ho et al., 2020）扩展到并行地消除所有视频标记的噪声。 相比之下，自回归视频模型按顺序生成标记：对于离散标记使用分类方法（Yan et al., 2021），而对于连续标记则使用扩散方法。 扩散强制法（Chen et al., 2024）通过训练一个模型来独立消除加噪帧的噪声，从而实现自回归视频扩散。 自强制法（Huang et al., 2025）指出，重复的自回归去噪会导致训练与推理分布不匹配，并通过在生成视频上额外训练来解决这一问题。 块扩散法（Arriola et al., 2025）提出了一种同时生成文本片段的方法，以加速语言建模。 我们发现块因果扩散法特别适合视频建模，因为它能够一次性生成完整的帧。 Flex-Forcing 方法（Ma et al., 2026）采用可变块大小的块因果扩散法，但他们仅探索了大于单帧的块大小，并将其作为一种在效率与质量之间存在权衡的加速技术。 我们探索了小于单帧的块大小，并研究了时空自回归如何影响逻辑一致性。

paragraphs.en: Oh et al. (2015) demonstrate action-conditioned video generation in Atari games. World models such as Genie 3 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) and Cosmos 3 ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) have scaled this to richer environments. These models are naturally autoregressive to allow users to submit actions that affect the generated video stream in real time. Thus, they already support the serial computation necessary for logical consistency. MIRA ( Hu et al., 2026 ) demonstrates remarkable physics consistency in the highly dynamic game of Rocket League. Our work explains the role of serial computation in achieving such high fidelity and shows that video models can achieve strong physical and logical consistency without a temporally dense action-conditioning signal. World models may also benefit from a parallel refinement stage.
paragraphs.zh: Oh 等人 (2015) 展示了在 Atari 游戏中基于动作的视频生成方法。 Genie 3（Google DeepMind，2025）和 Cosmos 3（NVIDIA，2026）等世界模型已将这一技术扩展到了更复杂的环境中。 这些模型天然具有自回归特性，允许用户提交实时影响所生成视频流的动作。 因此，它们已经支持实现逻辑一致性所需的串行计算。 MIRA（Hu 等人，2026）在高度动态的《火箭联盟》游戏中展现了出色的物理一致性。 我们的工作解释了串行计算在实现如此高保真度中的作用，并表明视频模型无需时间密集的动作条件信号，也能实现强大的物理和逻辑一致性。 世界模型也可能从并行优化阶段中受益。

sents.en: World models such as Genie 3 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) and Cosmos 3 ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) have scaled this to richer environments.
sents.zh: Genie 3（Google DeepMind，2025）和 Cosmos 3（NVIDIA，2026）等世界模型已将这一技术扩展到了更复杂的环境中。

sents.en: These models are naturally autoregressive to allow users to submit actions that affect the generated video stream in real time.
sents.zh: 这些模型天然具有自回归特性，允许用户提交实时影响所生成视频流的动作。

sents.en: Thus, they already support the serial computation necessary for logical consistency.
sents.zh: 因此，它们已经支持实现逻辑一致性所需的串行计算。

sents.en: MIRA ( Hu et al., 2026 ) demonstrates remarkable physics consistency in the highly dynamic game of Rocket League.
sents.zh: MIRA（Hu 等人，2026）在高度动态的《火箭联盟》游戏中展现了出色的物理一致性。

sents.en: Our work explains the role of serial computation in achieving such high fidelity and shows that video models can achieve strong physical and logical consistency without a temporally dense action-conditioning signal.
sents.zh: 我们的工作解释了串行计算在实现如此高保真度中的作用，并表明视频模型无需时间密集的动作条件信号，也能实现强大的物理和逻辑一致性。

sents.en: World models may also benefit from a parallel refinement stage.
sents.zh: 世界模型也可能从并行优化阶段中受益。

paragraphs.en: Frontier coding models such as GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and Claude Fable 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) can also reconstruct scenes and run simulations through code and software tools. paragraphs.en: Numerous benchmarks such as Physics-IQ ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) , PhyWorldBench ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , T2VPhysBench ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , and PhyGround ( Lin et al., 2026 ) test whether video models correctly capture physical laws and dynamics. Although these benchmarks remain unsaturated, their real-world setting and generalization demands make it difficult to isolate the causes of failure. We study simpler games and simulations, where video parsing provides quantitative feedback on rule violations and physical error, before scaling up to more complex datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 众多基准测试，例如 Physics-IQ（Motamed 等人，2026）、PhyWorldBench（Gu 等人，2026）、T2VPhysBench（Guo 等人，2025）和 PhyGround（Lin 等人，2026），用于检验视频模型能否正确捕捉物理定律与动态过程。 尽管这些基准测试尚未达到饱和状态，但其真实世界设定与泛化要求使得孤立失败原因变得困难。 在转向更复杂的数据集之前，我们研究了更简单的游戏与模拟环境，其中视频解析能为规则违反和物理错误提供定量反馈。

paragraphs.en: When flattening a 3D video token grid into a sequence, we first define a consistent token order and use 3D RoPE to retain information about the tokens’ spatial and temporal positions after flattening. See Section 5.1 for the token order ablation. We then group consecutive tokens into K K blocks B 0 , … , B K − 1 B^{0},\ldots,B^{K-1} of block size b b . Tokens within a block share a noise level during training and are denoised together during inference. Smaller blocks allow more autoregressive steps during sampling. When the block size equals the total sequence length, generation becomes equivalent to full-video bidirectional diffusion.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 a, bidirectional diffusion uses standard self-attention and one noise level for the entire video. Each video token can attend to all video tokens during training and the entire sequence is denoised in parallel during inference. As shown in Figure 2 b, Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) uses independent noise levels for each block during training. This enables autoregressive generation because the model learns to denoise each block using the surrounding partially noised context. We implement a causal version of Diffusion Forcing Transformer ( Song et al., 2025 ) , which we refer to as cDF, to better suit autoregressive generation. We replace the default self-attention with block-causal attention. Block-causal attention restricts each block to attend only to itself and preceding blocks. As shown in Figure 2 c, block-causal diffusion ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) , which we refer to as BC, uses two copies of the token sequence: a context copy with one noise level t c t_{c} and a target copy with independent noise levels t k t_{k} . We denote context and target blocks, B c k B_{c}^{k} and B t k B_{t}^{k} , respectively. Each context block attends to itself and preceding context blocks. Each target block attends to itself and preceding context blocks, but not other target blocks. Loss is computed only on the target blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2a 所示，双向扩散在整个视频中均使用标准的自注意机制和单一噪声水平。 在训练过程中，每个视频标记都可以关注所有其他视频标记，而在推理阶段，整个序列会被并行地去除噪声。 如图 2b 所示，扩散强制（Chen et al., 2024）在训练期间为每个块使用独立的噪声水平。 这使得自回归生成成为可能，因为模型能够学习利用周围部分去噪的上下文来为每个块去除噪声。 我们实现了一个因果版本的扩散强制变换器（Song et al., 2025），并将其称为 cDF，以更好地适应自回归生成。 我们将默认的自注意机制替换为块因果注意机制。 块因果注意机制限制每个块只能关注自身以及前面的块。 如图 2c 所示，块因果扩散（Arriola et al., 2025），我们将其称为 BC，使用标记序列的两个副本：一个具有单一噪声水平 t c t_{c} 的上下文副本和一个具有独立噪声水平 t k t_{k} 的目标副本。 我们将上下文块和目标块分别表示为 B c k B_{c}^{k} 和 B t k B_{t}^{k}。 每个上下文块都会关注自身以及前面的上下文块。 每个目标块会关注自身以及前面的上下文块，但不会关注其他目标块。 损失函数仅针对目标块进行计算。

paragraphs.en: S2PD generates blocks autoregressively at high noise before refining the whole video together in parallel at low noise. As shown in Figure 2 d, we define a transition noise level τ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tau\in[0,1] to separate the two phases. By default, we use ten uniformly spaced denoising steps and τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 to allocate four denoising steps to serial denoising and six to parallel refinement. Let N f N_{f} denote the number of tokens in one temporal slice of the video token grid and N v N_{v} the number of tokens in the full video. We use a block size b ≤ N f b\leq N_{f} for serial denoising and b = N v b=N_{v} for parallel refinement.

paragraphs.en: We initialize blocks of size b b with Gaussian noise and denoise them autoregressively from t = 1 t=1 to t = τ t=\tau . Each block is conditioned on a key–value (KV) cache of previously generated blocks at noise level τ \tau . We follow the token order shown in Figure 2 e. paragraphs.en: We implement all four methods—Bidirectional, cDF, BC, and S2PD—with two architectures: DiT-B and Wan-5B-LoRA. DiT-B is a 132.7M-parameter diffusion transformer ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) trained from scratch in pixel space. Wan-5B-LoRA is a pretrained latent-space video diffusion model adapted using rank-32 LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) with 80.6M trainable parameters in total. In Wan-5B, we replace the default attention mask with each method’s custom attention pattern and let the adapters adapt. Since BC and S2PD use double the sequence length during training, we double the batch size used by Bidirectional and cDF to compensate. This matches training token budgets and roughly matches total training FLOPs. For more implementation details, see Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用两种架构——DiT-B 和 Wan-5B-LoRA，实现了全部四种方法：Bidirectional、cDF、BC 和 S2PD。 DiT-B 是一种包含 132.7M 个参数的扩散变换器（Peebles & Xie, 2023），在像素空间从零开始训练。 Wan-5B-LoRA 是一种预训练的潜在空间视频扩散模型，通过秩为 32 的 LoRA（Hu et al., 2022）进行适配，总共包含 80.6M 个可训练参数。 在 Wan-5B 中，我们将默认的注意力掩码替换为每种方法自定义的注意力模式，并让适配器进行适配。 由于 BC 和 S2PD 在训练时使用的序列长度是其他方法的两倍，因此我们将 Bidirectional 和 cDF 使用的批量大小加倍以作补偿。 这使得训练令牌预算相匹配，并且大致匹配总训练 FLOPs。 更多实现细节请参见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: First, we implement Conway’s Game of Life ( Gardner, 1970 ) , a zero-player game where a grid of live and dead cells evolves deterministically. At each step, all cells update simultaneously according to their neighbors. A live cell survives if it has two or three live neighbors and dies otherwise. A dead cell comes to life if it has exactly three live neighbors. To create our video dataset, we hold each step for p t p_{t} frames, aligning state transitions with token boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们实现了康威的生命游戏（Gardner, 1970），这是一种零玩家游戏，其中由活细胞和死细胞组成的网格会按照确定性规则演化。 在每一步中，所有细胞都会根据它们的邻居同时更新状态。 一个活细胞如果拥有两个或三个活邻居则会存活，否则就会死亡。 一个死细胞如果恰好有三个活邻居则会变为活细胞。 为了创建我们的视频数据集，我们将每一步保留 p t p_{t} 帧，使状态转换与词元边界对齐。

sents.en: To create our video dataset, we hold each step for p t p_{t} frames, aligning state transitions with token boundaries.
sents.zh: 为了创建我们的视频数据集，我们将每一步保留 p t p_{t} 帧，使状态转换与词元边界对齐。

paragraphs.en: Next, we add other discrete datasets like Chess, 2048, 15 Puzzle, Tetris, Snake, and Rubik’s Cube 3D. We animate transitions between states to make the dynamics easier for a video model to learn. Animations occupy the first p t − 1 p_{t}-1 frames of each temporal block but are not used during evaluation. We parse only the settled frame at the end of the state transition. If the game ends early, we overlay an end-of-game modal and retain it for the rest of the video.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们加入其他离散数据集，例如国际象棋、2048、15 滑块谜题、俄罗斯方块、贪吃蛇和魔方 3D。 我们对状态之间的转换进行动画处理，以便视频模型更容易学习其动态变化。 动画占据每个时间块中前 p t − 1 p_{t}-1 帧，但在评估过程中不会被使用。 我们仅解析状态转换结束时已稳定的那一帧画面。 如果游戏提前结束，我们会叠加一个游戏结束模态框，并在视频剩余部分保留该模态框。

paragraphs.en: Lastly, we include datasets with more complex simulations and real video. These datasets are pre-generated offline, downloaded with their official splits, or collected ourselves. paragraphs.en: For simple datasets, we evaluate generated videos by parsing them into symbolic states and checking whether their transitions obey the underlying game rules or physical dynamics. Discrete datasets evolve through a finite set of transitions on a fixed grid. Since the grid positions are known ahead of time, we parse their videos through template matching of their grid cells. Then, we evaluate each pair independently, checking state validity and the permitted changes between frames. Persistent invalid states incur repeated penalties. We count invalid transitions per rollout as our primary metric. For Rubik’s Cube 3D, since the camera pose is unknown, we fit a 3D cube to the 2D silhouette before parsing the facelet colors. For continuous datasets, we track expected objects and fit simulation parameters. Then, we account for occlusions and measure deviations from the expected dynamics. We report cumulative error as dynamics error per rollout . We use red diagnostic overlays to localize the errors we detect and verify each dataset evaluation procedure manually on generated samples. We invite the reader to use our project page to do the same. Parsing and tracking failures complicate our evaluation metrics. For more details, see Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 对于简单数据集，我们通过将生成的视频解析为符号状态，并检查其状态转换是否符合底层的游戏规则或物理动力学来评估这些视频。 离散数据集通过固定网格上有限的一组转换进行演化。 由于网格位置是预先已知的，我们通过对其网格单元进行模板匹配来解析其视频。 然后，我们独立评估每一对数据，检查状态的有效性以及帧之间允许的变化。 持续存在的无效状态会导致重复的惩罚。 我们将每次运行中的无效转换次数作为主要指标。 对于魔方 3D 数据集，由于相机姿态未知，我们会在解析面块颜色之前，先对 2D 轮廓进行 3D 立方体拟合。 对于连续数据集，我们会跟踪预期对象并拟合模拟参数。 然后，我们会考虑遮挡情况，并测量与预期动力学之间的偏差。 我们将累积误差报告为每次运行的动力学误差。 我们使用红色诊断叠加层来定位检测到的错误，并在生成的样本上手动验证每个数据集的评估流程。 我们邀请读者通过我们的项目页面执行相同的操作。 解析和跟踪失败会使我们的评估指标变得复杂。 更多详情请参见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: With these metrics, Figure 4 shows that the bidirectional baseline never learns to generate valid transitions for Conway over the course of training. In contrast, our method rapidly learns the rules and generates videos with almost no errors. Our video parsing and metrics do not require a pixel-aligned ground-truth video for evaluation. We evaluate each sample against the underlying rules and dynamics of the simulator. Figure 5 shows that our method produces diverse valid continuations from a single image. However, for video datasets that are too complex to parse reliably, we fall back to using distributional metrics like FVD. We adopt CD-FVD ( Ge et al., 2024 ) as our primary distributional metric because it uses a more modern feature extractor and has been shown to have less bias toward per-frame appearance and greater sensitivity to temporal distortions than FVD. Nonetheless, we also report FVD in Appendix C.2 .

paragraphs.en: The Serial Scaling Hypothesis ( Liu et al., 2026 ) proved that diffusion models are not very effective at modeling serial computation. Videos are full of causal dependencies that require serial computation. Across a collection of games and physical simulations, we demonstrate that scaling training data does not enable bidirectional diffusion models to model complex video. Across many datasets and two architectures, we show serial methods outperform the parallel baseline with matched model sizes and training budgets. We introduce S2PD, a simple extension to block-causal diffusion that establishes video structure through autoregressive denoising at high noise levels before refining the details in parallel. This preserves physical and logical consistency from serial computation while improving sampling efficiency and temporal stability over other serial methods.
paragraphs.zh: 序列扩展假说（Liu 等人，2026）证明，扩散模型在模拟序列计算方面的效果并不理想。 视频中充满了需要序列计算的因果依赖关系。 通过一系列游戏和物理模拟实验，我们证明，增加训练数据规模并不能使双向扩散模型有效模拟复杂的视频内容。 在多个数据集和两种架构中，我们发现，在模型规模和训练预算相同的情况下，序列方法的表现优于并行基线方法。 我们提出了 S2PD，这是一种对块因果扩散模型的简单扩展，它通过在高噪声水平下进行自回归去噪来建立视频结构，随后以并行方式优化细节。 这种方法既保留了序列计算所带来的物理和逻辑一致性，又比其他序列方法具有更高的采样效率和更稳定的时间表现。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 summarizes architectural, training, and sampling hyperparameters for DiT-B and Wan-5B-LoRA models. For DiT-B, we use pixel-space diffusion with x x -prediction and v v -loss. For Wan-5B-LoRA, we use latent-space diffusion with v v -prediction and v v -loss. Both architectures encode text prompts with Wan’s frozen UMT5-XXL encoder. We project text token embeddings to the transformer’s width and feed them into each transformer block via cross-attention. We use a fixed prompt for each dataset except MPMWorlds. Training Wan-5B-LoRA takes about 48 hours on four nodes with four H100 GPUs each. We train for 100 epochs with 1,000 steps per epoch. To standardize training across finite and procedurally generated datasets, we define one epoch as 1,000 optimizer steps and use batch sizes of 32 or 64, depending on the method. For finite datasets, we repeat samples to fill epochs. We evaluate EMA checkpoints on validation splits. For datasets that are simulated on-the-fly, we use dedicated validation seeds that are distinct from the training seeds.

sents.zh: 我们利用模拟器的动力学模型，根据过往帧推断出每一帧的内容，并将该预测结果与生成视频中观察到的内容进行比较。

sents.en: For each object, let P t , i P_{t,i} and O t , i O_{t,i} be its predicted and observed regions at time t t .
sents.zh: 对于每个物体，设 P t , i P_{t,i} 和 O t , i O_{t,i} 分别为其在时间 t t 时的预测区域和观测区域。

sents.en: Its residual is 1 − IoU ⁡ ( P t , i , O t , i ) 1-\operatorname{IoU}(P_{t,i},O_{t,i}) after a small positional tolerance for parsing error.
sents.zh: 在考虑解析误差的小范围位置容差后，其残差为 1 − IoU ⁡ ( P t , i , O t , i ) 1-\operatorname{IoU}(P_{t,i},O_{t,i})。

sents.en: We average the residual over the source’s objects and report the sum over frames as dynamics error per rollout .
sents.zh: 我们对源数据中的各个物体的残差取平均值，并将各帧的残差总和报告为每次运行中的动力学误差。

sents.en: An expected object that is missing counts as a full residual error for each frame that it is missing.
sents.zh: 每个缺失的预期物体，在其缺失的每一帧中都会计为一次完整的残差误差。

paragraphs.en: Conway. Each grid must follow from the previous grid under Conway’s rules.
paragraphs.zh: 康威。 每个网格都必须根据康威的规则由前一个网格推导出来。

sents.en: Conway.
sents.zh: 康威。

sents.en: Each grid must follow from the previous grid under Conway’s rules.

paragraphs.en: Chess. Each side must have one king, and pawns cannot stand on the first or last rank. We infer the moving side from the first valid transition, then enforce alternating turns. We infer possible castling and en-passant rights from the visible board. Moving a pinned piece is illegal. A win modal must follow a visible checkmate. We accept a draw modal after any valid board without checkmate. An invalid modal counts as one error when it appears.
paragraphs.zh: 国际象棋。 每方必须有一枚王，且兵不能位于第一排或最后一排。 我们从第一个有效的状态转换中推断出移动方，然后强制执行轮流走棋的规则。 我们从可见的棋盘上推断出可能的王车易位和吃过路兵权利。 移动被牵制的棋子是非法的。 获胜提示框必须出现在可见的将死之后。 在任何没有将死的合法棋盘状态后，我们都会接受和棋提示框。 无效的提示框出现时计为一次错误。

sents.en: Chess.
sents.zh: 国际象棋。

sents.en: Each side must have one king, and pawns cannot stand on the first or last rank.
sents.zh: 每方必须有一枚王，且兵不能位于第一排或最后一排。

sents.en: We infer the moving side from the first valid transition, then enforce alternating turns.
sents.zh: 我们从第一个有效的状态转换中推断出移动方，然后强制执行轮流走棋的规则。

sents.en: We infer possible castling and en-passant rights from the visible board.
sents.zh: 我们从可见的棋盘上推断出可能的王车易位和吃过路兵权利。

sents.en: Moving a pinned piece is illegal.
sents.zh: 移动被牵制的棋子是非法的。

sents.en: A win modal must follow a visible checkmate.
sents.zh: 获胜提示框必须出现在可见的将死之后。

sents.zh: 在任何没有将死的合法棋盘状态后，我们都会接受和棋提示框。

sents.en: An invalid modal counts as one error when it appears.
sents.zh: 无效的提示框出现时计为一次错误。

paragraphs.en: 2048. Each transition must consist of a horizontal or vertical slide that changes the board, followed by the appearance of a new 2 or 4 tile in an empty cell.
paragraphs.zh: 2048。 每次转换都必须由一次水平或垂直的滑动组成，该滑动会改变棋盘，随后在一个空单元格中出现一个新的 2 或 4 的方块。

sents.en: Each transition must consist of a horizontal or vertical slide that changes the board, followed by the appearance of a new 2 or 4 tile in an empty cell.
sents.zh: 每次转换都必须由一次水平或垂直的滑动组成，该滑动会改变棋盘，随后在一个空单元格中出现一个新的 2 或 4 的方块。

paragraphs.en: Fifteen Puzzle. Each board must contain every numbered tile and one blank exactly once. A move slides a tile adjacent to the blank into that space.
paragraphs.zh: 十五谜题。 每个棋盘必须恰好包含每一块带编号的瓷砖和一块空白格，且仅出现一次。 一次移动是将与空白格相邻的瓷砖滑动到该空格中。

sents.en: Fifteen Puzzle.
sents.zh: 十五谜题。

sents.en: Each board must contain every numbered tile and one blank exactly once.
sents.zh: 每个棋盘必须恰好包含每一块带编号的瓷砖和一块空白格，且仅出现一次。

sents.en: A move slides a tile adjacent to the blank into that space.
sents.zh: 一次移动是将与空白格相邻的瓷砖滑动到该空格中。

paragraphs.en: Tetris. The previewed piece must drop vertically into a column and reach its resting position when the board has no full rows. When the board contains full rows, the next transition must clear them and shift the rows above downward, leaving the preview unchanged. We allow any rotation of the dropped piece, and the preview after a drop may show any piece.
paragraphs.zh: 俄罗斯方块。 当棋盘中没有完整行时，预览的方块必须垂直落入某一列，并到达其静止位置。 当棋盘中存在完整行时，下一次转换必须清除这些行，并将上方的行向下移动，同时保持预览不变。 我们允许对落下的方块进行任意旋转，且下落后的预览可以显示任何方块。

sents.en: Tetris.
sents.zh: 俄罗斯方块。

sents.en: The previewed piece must drop vertically into a column and reach its resting position when the board has no full rows.
sents.zh: 当棋盘中没有完整行时，预览的方块必须垂直落入某一列，并到达其静止位置。

sents.en: When the board contains full rows, the next transition must clear them and shift the rows above downward, leaving the preview unchanged.
sents.zh: 当棋盘中存在完整行时，下一次转换必须清除这些行，并将上方的行向下移动，同时保持预览不变。

sents.en: We allow any rotation of the dropped piece, and the preview after a drop may show any piece.
sents.zh: 我们允许对落下的方块进行任意旋转，且下落后的预览可以显示任何方块。

paragraphs.en: Snake. A valid board contains one connected chain from head to tail and one food cell. On each move, the head advances to a free neighboring cell and the tail moves forward. If the head reaches food, the snake grows instead, and new food appears in an empty cell. An end-of-game modal is valid only when the preceding board is valid and the head is trapped.
paragraphs.zh: 蛇。 一个有效的棋盘包含一条从头到尾的连通链和一个食物单元格。 在每一步移动中，头部会向前移动到相邻的空单元格，而尾部也会向前移动。 如果头部到达食物，蛇反而会变长，并且会在一个空单元格中出现新的食物。 只有在前一个棋盘有效且头部被包围时，游戏结束模态框才是有效的。

sents.en: Snake.
sents.zh: 蛇。

sents.en: A valid board contains one connected chain from head to tail and one food cell.
sents.zh: 一个有效的棋盘包含一条从头到尾的连通链和一个食物单元格。

sents.en: On each move, the head advances to a free neighboring cell and the tail moves forward.
sents.zh: 在每一步移动中，头部会向前移动到相邻的空单元格，而尾部也会向前移动。

sents.en: If the head reaches food, the snake grows instead, and new food appears in an empty cell.
sents.zh: 如果头部到达食物，蛇反而会变长，并且会在一个空单元格中出现新的食物。

sents.en: An end-of-game modal is valid only when the preceding board is valid and the head is trapped.
sents.zh: 只有在前一个棋盘有效且头部被包围时，游戏结束模态框才是有效的。

paragraphs.en: Rubik’s Cube 3D. We fit a cube to its silhouette and parse the colors of the visible facelets. The silhouette determines the camera orientation only up to a quarter turn. We therefore test the possible camera orientations and legal quarter turns, accepting a transition if one combination matches every facelet visible in both frames. We do not enforce color counts or solvability, and hidden colors remain unconstrained. The metric thus checks local motion rather than persistent identity through occlusion.
paragraphs.zh: 鲁比克魔方 3D。 我们将一个立方体拟合到其轮廓，并解析可见面块的顏色。 该轮廓仅能确定相机方向在四分之一旋转范围内的唯一性。 因此，我们测试可能的相机方向和合法的¼旋转，如果某种组合与两帧中所有可见面块都匹配，则接受该转换。 我们不强制要求颜色数量或可解性，隐藏的颜色也保持不受约束。 因此，该指标检查的是局部运动，而非通过遮挡后持续存在的身份特征。

sents.en: Rubik’s Cube 3D.
sents.zh: 鲁比克魔方 3D。

sents.en: We fit a cube to its silhouette and parse the colors of the visible facelets.
sents.zh: 我们将一个立方体拟合到其轮廓，并解析可见面块的顏色。

sents.en: The silhouette determines the camera orientation only up to a quarter turn.
sents.zh: 该轮廓仅能确定相机方向在四分之一旋转范围内的唯一性。

sents.en: We therefore test the possible camera orientations and legal quarter turns, accepting a transition if one combination matches every facelet visible in both frames.
sents.zh: 因此，我们测试可能的相机方向和合法的¼旋转，如果某种组合与两帧中所有可见面块都匹配，则接受该转换。

sents.en: We do not enforce color counts or solvability, and hidden colors remain unconstrained.
sents.zh: 我们不强制要求颜色数量或可解性，隐藏的颜色也保持不受约束。

sents.en: The metric thus checks local motion rather than persistent identity through occlusion.
sents.zh: 因此，该指标检查的是局部运动，而非通过遮挡后持续存在的身份特征。

paragraphs.en: Colliding Balls 2D. We track balls by color and predict their motion using the simulator’s contact law, allowing collisions to occur between frames. We penalize new overlaps between balls and new penetrations of the table rails. Since balls cannot enter or leave the table, each unmatched arrival or departure incurs one full ball penalty.
paragraphs.zh: 2D 碰撞小球。 我们通过颜色追踪小球，并利用模拟器的接触定律预测其运动，从而允许小球在不同帧之间发生碰撞。 我们对小球之间的新重叠以及小球对桌边栏的新穿透施加惩罚。 由于小球无法进入或离开桌面，每次未匹配的出现或消失都将受到一次完整的小球惩罚。

sents.en: Colliding Balls 2D.
sents.zh: 2D 碰撞小球。

sents.en: We track balls by color and predict their motion using the simulator’s contact law, allowing collisions to occur between frames.
sents.zh: 我们通过颜色追踪小球，并利用模拟器的接触定律预测其运动，从而允许小球在不同帧之间发生碰撞。

sents.en: We penalize new overlaps between balls and new penetrations of the table rails.
sents.zh: 我们对小球之间的新重叠以及小球对桌边栏的新穿透施加惩罚。

sents.en: Since balls cannot enter or leave the table, each unmatched arrival or departure incurs one full ball penalty.
sents.zh: 由于小球无法进入或离开桌面，每次未匹配的出现或消失都将受到一次完整的小球惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Colliding Balls 3D. We estimate the camera pose from the table and apply the 2D checks in table coordinates. An arrival or departure is not penalized when a nearby visible ball could explain it through occlusion, or when the arriving or departing ball touches the image border. Each visible ball can account for at most one arrival and one departure per frame. We exclude balls clipped by the border from motion scoring and charge a failed table fit once when it begins.
paragraphs.zh: 3D 碰撞球体。 我们从桌面上估算相机姿态，并在桌面坐标系中应用二维检查。 如果附近可见的球体可以通过遮挡来解释某个到达或离开事件，或者该到达或离开的球体触及图像边界，则不对其进行惩罚。 每帧中，每个可见球体最多只能对应一次到达和一次离开。 我们将被边界裁剪的球体排除在运动评分之外，并在首次发生桌面拟合失败时计为一次失败。

sents.en: Colliding Balls 3D.
sents.zh: 3D 碰撞球体。

sents.en: We estimate the camera pose from the table and apply the 2D checks in table coordinates.
sents.zh: 我们从桌面上估算相机姿态，并在桌面坐标系中应用二维检查。

sents.en: An arrival or departure is not penalized when a nearby visible ball could explain it through occlusion, or when the arriving or departing ball touches the image border.
sents.zh: 如果附近可见的球体可以通过遮挡来解释某个到达或离开事件，或者该到达或离开的球体触及图像边界，则不对其进行惩罚。

sents.en: Each visible ball can account for at most one arrival and one departure per frame.
sents.zh: 每帧中，每个可见球体最多只能对应一次到达和一次离开。

sents.en: We exclude balls clipped by the border from motion scoring and charge a failed table fit once when it begins.
sents.zh: 我们将被边界裁剪的球体排除在运动评分之外，并在首次发生桌面拟合失败时计为一次失败。

paragraphs.en: Double Pendulum. We fit rod lengths and the mass ratio once per rollout, then use the pendulum equations to predict motion. Observed rod lengths must remain close to their rollout medians. Unexplained missing bobs incur a full-frame penalty. Only the second bob may leave the image without penalty. Its last observations must place it near the edge or moving beyond it, and its rod must be long enough to reach outside the image.
paragraphs.zh: 双摆。 我们在每次运行中拟合一次杆长和质量比，然后使用摆的方程来预测运动。 观测到的杆长必须保持接近其运行中的中位数。 无法解释的摆锤缺失将导致整帧惩罚。 只有第二个摆锤可以离开图像而不会受到惩罚。 其最后的观测结果必须显示它靠近边缘或正在超出边缘移动，并且其杆必须足够长以延伸到图像之外。

sents.en: Double Pendulum.
sents.zh: 双摆。

sents.en: We fit rod lengths and the mass ratio once per rollout, then use the pendulum equations to predict motion.
sents.zh: 我们在每次运行中拟合一次杆长和质量比，然后使用摆的方程来预测运动。

sents.en: Observed rod lengths must remain close to their rollout medians.
sents.zh: 观测到的杆长必须保持接近其运行中的中位数。

sents.en: Unexplained missing bobs incur a full-frame penalty.
sents.zh: 无法解释的摆锤缺失将导致整帧惩罚。

sents.en: Only the second bob may leave the image without penalty.
sents.zh: 只有第二个摆锤可以离开图像而不会受到惩罚。

sents.en: Its last observations must place it near the edge or moving beyond it, and its rod must be long enough to reach outside the image.
sents.zh: 其最后的观测结果必须显示它靠近边缘或正在超出边缘移动，并且其杆必须足够长以延伸到图像之外。

paragraphs.en: Three Body. We fit gravity once per rollout and predict each body’s motion from the forces exerted by visible bodies. When recent motion indicates that a body has left the image or become occluded, we do not penalize its absence until it returns. A body missing from the start is penalized on every frame in which it is absent.
paragraphs.zh: 三体。 我们在每次 rollout 中拟合一次引力，并根据可见天体施加的力来预测每个天体的运动。 当近期的运动表明某个天体已离开图像或被遮挡时，我们不会对其缺席进行惩罚，直到它重新出现。 如果某个天体从一开始就缺失，则会在它缺席的每一帧中受到惩罚。

sents.en: Three Body.
sents.zh: 三体。

sents.en: We fit gravity once per rollout and predict each body’s motion from the forces exerted by visible bodies.
sents.zh: 我们在每次 rollout 中拟合一次引力，并根据可见天体施加的力来预测每个天体的运动。

sents.en: When recent motion indicates that a body has left the image or become occluded, we do not penalize its absence until it returns.
sents.zh: 当近期的运动表明某个天体已离开图像或被遮挡时，我们不会对其缺席进行惩罚，直到它重新出现。

sents.en: A body missing from the start is penalized on every frame in which it is absent.
sents.zh: 如果某个天体从一开始就缺失，则会在它缺席的每一帧中受到惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Pong. We predict ball motion using the simulator’s wall and paddle collisions. Paddles must remain on their rails and inside the court. After crossing a goal line, the ball may reappear at the serve position. Other missing or extra objects incur a penalty on every affected frame.
paragraphs.zh: 乒乓球。 我们利用模拟器的墙壁和球拍碰撞来预测球的运动轨迹。 球拍必须保持在轨道上且位于球台内部。 穿过球门线后，球可能会重新出现在发球位置。 其他缺失或多余的物体将在每个受影响的帧中受到惩罚。

sents.en: Pong.
sents.zh: 乒乓球。

sents.en: We predict ball motion using the simulator’s wall and paddle collisions.
sents.zh: 我们利用模拟器的墙壁和球拍碰撞来预测球的运动轨迹。

sents.en: Paddles must remain on their rails and inside the court.
sents.zh: 球拍必须保持在轨道上且位于球台内部。

sents.en: After crossing a goal line, the ball may reappear at the serve position.
sents.zh: 穿过球门线后，球可能会重新出现在发球位置。

sents.en: Other missing or extra objects incur a penalty on every affected frame.
sents.zh: 其他缺失或多余的物体将在每个受影响的帧中受到惩罚。

paragraphs.en: All autoregressive diffusion methods require re-noising of generated outputs to mitigate autoregressive drift. We sweep the context noise level t c t_{c} for BC and cDF and the transition noise level τ \tau for S2PD from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, with matched block sizes. Table 8 shows that t c = 0.2 t_{c}=0.2 works best for BC and cDF and τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 works best for S2PD. S2PD achieves the lowest score across all methods.
paragraphs.zh: 所有自回归扩散方法都需要对生成的输出进行重新加噪，以缓解自回归漂移问题。 我们对 BC 和 cDF 的上下文噪声水平 t c t_{c}，以及 S2PD 的过渡噪声水平 τ \tau，在 0.0 到 1.0 的范围内以 0.2 为步长进行扫描，同时保持块大小匹配。 表 8 显示，对于 BC 和 cDF，t c = 0.2 t_{c}=0.2 的效果最佳；而对于 S2PD，τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 的效果最佳。 S2PD 在所有方法中得分最低。

sents.en: All autoregressive diffusion methods require re-noising of generated outputs to mitigate autoregressive drift.
sents.zh: 所有自回归扩散方法都需要对生成的输出进行重新加噪，以缓解自回归漂移问题。

sents.en: We sweep the context noise level t c t_{c} for BC and cDF and the transition noise level τ \tau for S2PD from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, with matched block sizes.
sents.zh: 我们对 BC 和 cDF 的上下文噪声水平 t c t_{c}，以及 S2PD 的过渡噪声水平 τ \tau，在 0.0 到 1.0 的范围内以 0.2 为步长进行扫描，同时保持块大小匹配。

sents.en: Table 8 shows that t c = 0.2 t_{c}=0.2 works best for BC and cDF and τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 works best for S2PD.
sents.zh: 表 8 显示，对于 BC 和 cDF，t c = 0.2 t_{c}=0.2 的效果最佳；而对于 S2PD，τ = 0.6 \tau=0.6 的效果最佳。

sents.en: S2PD achieves the lowest score across all methods.
sents.zh: S2PD 在所有方法中得分最低。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 reports FVD scores, which broadly agree with the CD-FVD scores. S2PD achieves the lowest FVD on both Kubric datasets and the MPMWorlds dataset. However, cDF and BC outperform our method on the Rubik’s Cube Real dataset. We attribute this to the limited diversity of the real-world dataset. For both FVD and CD-FVD, we exclude the condition image and compare features from temporally subsampled 16-frame windows.
paragraphs.zh: 表9报告了FVD分数，这些分数与CD-FVD分数大体一致。 S2PD在Kubric数据集和MPMWorlds数据集上都获得了最低的FVD分数。 然而，在Rubik’s Cube Real数据集上，cDF和BC的表现优于我们的方法。 我们将此归因于该真实世界数据集的多样性有限。 对于FVD和CD-FVD，我们排除了条件图像，并比较了时间上子采样的16帧窗口中的特征。

sents.en: Table 9 reports FVD scores, which broadly agree with the CD-FVD scores.
sents.zh: 表9报告了FVD分数，这些分数与CD-FVD分数大体一致。

sents.en: S2PD achieves the lowest FVD on both Kubric datasets and the MPMWorlds dataset.

sents.en: However, cDF and BC outperform our method on the Rubik’s Cube Real dataset.

sents.en: We attribute this to the limited diversity of the real-world dataset.
sents.zh: 我们将此归因于该真实世界数据集的多样性有限。

sents.en: For both FVD and CD-FVD, we exclude the condition image and compare features from temporally subsampled 16-frame windows.
sents.zh: 对于FVD和CD-FVD，我们排除了条件图像，并比较了时间上子采样的16帧窗口中的特征。

paragraphs.en: We obtained the MPMWorlds dataset from its authors ( Kovačič & Ellis, 2026 ) . We retime all video from 30 fps to 24 fps without dropping frames. Their evaluation code was not available at the time of our experiments, so we could not run their exact metrics. However, we implemented our own versions of the metrics based on their paper. Table 10 reports these metrics for all four of our methods. These metrics assess foreground overlap, object collapse, motion, color, and temporal consistency. Unfortunately, these metrics depend strongly on pixel-wise alignment with the ground-truth reference video. We used a short text description rather than code conditioning to keep the setup consistent with the other datasets. Generated samples are not expected to match their corresponding ground truth videos exactly. This is especially true for MPMWorlds as physical parameters such as rigidity and viscosity cannot be inferred from the initial image alone, yet significantly affect how the scene will evolve. This ambiguity renders these metrics useless to us, but strong code conditioning is an interesting direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从其作者（Kovačič & Ellis，2026）处获得了 MPMWorlds 数据集。 我们将所有视频从 30 fps 重新调整到 24 fps，且未丢弃任何帧。 在我们进行实验时，他们的评估代码尚未公开，因此我们无法运行他们使用的精确指标。 不过，我们根据他们的论文实现了这些指标的自有版本。 表 10 报告了我们的四种方法在这些指标上的结果。 这些指标用于评估前景重叠、物体坍缩、运动、颜色和时间一致性。 遗憾的是，这些指标严重依赖于与基准参考视频在像素级上的对齐。 为了保持设置与其他数据集一致，我们使用了简短的文本描述而非代码条件约束。 生成的样本并不被期望与对应的基准视频完全一致。 对于 MPMWorlds 而言这一点尤其明显，因为仅凭初始图像无法推断出刚度和黏性等物理参数，而这些参数却显著影响场景的演化过程。 这种模糊性使得这些指标对我们而言毫无用处，但采用强代码条件约束是值得未来探索的一个有趣方向。
